title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: Version 1.4.1 consolidates course stabilization and adds the Week 10.1 reading companion on ab initio Jager Ar-Ar collision DeepONet. Author-supplied research fields are visualized with shared-color temperature, Mach, pressure and density contours, verified hashes and explicit asynchronous-snapshot limits. The later DeepONet package is distinguished from the original PoF 38, 057123 MLP and from the Week 7.1 field-surrogate case. This release also retains the improved Week 7.1 classroom MLP, scientific documentation landing page, per-case research attribution, notebook scratch-output protections, and SPARTA pilot safeguards. Software is MIT licensed; dataset and third-party solver rights remain separately scoped. No new DSMC campaign or original-paper speedup reproduction is claimed.
